output.scope_note: The paper studies Ge/Ta co-doped garnet Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolytes and reports room-temperature Li-ion conductivity values from impedance measurements.

records.evidence_quote: which has the maximum ionic conductivity of 6.61 x 10 -4 S/cm at 250C among all the samples.
records.notes: Sintering was written as 10500 C (read as 1050 °C). The temperature '250C' is most likely a typo for 25 °C but is recorded as written, so measurement_temperature_C is null. Activation energy 0.25 eV is from the abstract and section 3.4.2 for the same 0.25 Ta sample. Relative density is not given as a percentage (only 4.77 g/cm3 and a theoretical density from Rietveld refinement), so it is null. The air-exposed value 5.95 x 10-4 S/cm was not recorded because its measurement temperature is not stated.
